source_text: Infections, facilitated by unsterilized blades and razors commonly used by traditional practitioners, include sepsis at rates of 1.4% to 7.6% and tetanus at 0.18% to 2.3%, with Nigerian case series reporting fatalities such as tetanus deaths in infants and a septic adult woman. [35]
